A.text: The degree of clotting factor deficiency generally parallels the severity of bleeding in hemophilia, so a greater deficiency predicts more severe bleeding.

B.text: Severity generally parallels the degree of deficiency, so equal severity regardless of factor level is not expected.

C.text: Because severity parallels the degree of deficiency, a greater deficiency does not predict milder bleeding.

D.text: Poor oral hygiene is one source of gum bleeding, but severity generally parallels the degree of factor deficiency, so it is not independent of factor level.

explanation.text: In hemophilia, the degree of clotting factor deficiency generally parallels the severity of bleeding manifestations.
